facts.claim: Blended annual ARPU runs 3 to 15 dollars for hybrid freemium, 0.40 to 2 dollars for ad-only free tiers and 30 to 100 dollars or more for subscription-led products
facts.source_title: Subscription vs ads for AI apps: which model wins in 2026
facts.excerpt: Hybrid freemium blended annual ARPU lands in the $3-$15 range, against $0.40-$2 for ad-only free tiers and $30-$100+ for subscription-led.

facts.claim: Subscription apps earn 4.6 times the average revenue per user of ad-only apps
facts.source_title: Subscription vs ads for AI apps: which model wins in 2026
facts.excerpt: Subscription-based apps pull in 4.6x higher ARPU compared to ad-only apps.

facts.claim: AI apps convert free to paid at 1% to 3%, against 5% to 8% for mature subscription mobile apps
facts.source_title: Subscription vs ads for AI apps: which model wins in 2026
facts.excerpt: For AI apps, free-to-paid conversion tends toward 1-3% rather than the 5-8% seen in mature subscription mobile apps.
